notes: Build81 restores only the real visual shell of Lovable Decrypter on top of the stable Build80 injection baseline. The shipped extension still has no background service worker, no general permissions, no optional permissions, no storage runtime, no network runtime, no polling, no MutationObserver, no Composer Guardian, no Composer Bridge, no AI execution and no backend/provider execution. Host access remains limited to lovable.dev and subdomains. A single document_start content script mounts the original-style FAB artwork, panel, status cards, local navigation and disabled composer using createElement/textContent and Shadow DOM. Navigation changes only local diagnostic text. No runtime actions are dispatched. The dormant update-manager artifact remains unreferenced by the manifest and cannot execute.
